{{recipesummary|category=Pasta recipes|servings=6|time=½ hour|difficulty=1|image=[[File:Plated penne pasta with hearty meat sauce.jpg|300px]]}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] 

==Ingredients==

* 1 package (20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) Italian [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]]
* 1 can (26½ ounces) meat-flavored [[Cookbook:Spaghetti Sauce|spaghetti sauce]]
* 1 can (6 ounces) [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] hot [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 8 ounces dry penne [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]], cooked according to package directions
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] shredded [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]

==Procedure==

# Remove casings from sausages.
# Cook sausage in large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat until browned and crumbled; drain.
# Stir in spaghetti sauce, tomato paste, and water.
# Add pasta and stir until well coated.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Reduce heat, [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] over low heat 10 minutes or until heated through.
# Sprinkle with cheese.

<gallery mode="packed">
